style.backgroundSystem: matte black #0E0E10 dark gym studio for hero, scene, macro and closing shots; seamless pure white #FFFFFF and light warm gray #F2F0EC studio backdrops for packshot and infographic shots
style.direction: dark performance gym commerce, chrome-and-black hardware presentation
style.iconSystem: thin-line white icons inside flat signal-red #D62828 hexagon badges, one icon per badge, no gradients, consistent line weight
style.lightingSystem: cool directional studio lighting, front-left or top-left key with a cool rim highlight on polished chrome, soft contact shadows, strong contrast on dark backgrounds, no warm cast
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dark gym performance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of matte black background #0E0E10, pure white #FFFFFF, light warm gray #F2F0EC and one signal red accent #D62828; cool color temperature; consistent dark textured rubber gym floor, matte black studio backdrop and seamless white or light-gray studio surfaces; cool directional studio lighting with a front-left or top-left key and cool rim highlights on polished chrome plus soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif type in #F5F5F5 on dark and #1A1A1A on light backgrounds, headlines 28-48pt, subtitles 16-20pt, labels 10-14pt; consistent rounded information labels and flat signal-red #D62828 hexagon icon badges with thin white line icons; polished chrome and matte black material rendering with true contact shadows; stable product scale and balanced centered composition with even margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no warm color cast on polished chrome
no invented weight, load-bearing or certification data
style.presentationRules: stable product scale, centered or balanced composition, the same plated hardware reads identically across shots, very low angle for scale in dark hero shots and 90-degree overhead flat lays for information shots
style.surfaceSystem: dark textured rubber gym floor #1A1A1C, matte black seamless backdrop, seamless white #FFFFFF and light warm gray #F2F0EC studio surfaces with subtle sheen
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, headlines 28-48pt, subtitles 16-20pt, labels 10-14pt; #F5F5F5 on dark backgrounds and #1A1A1A on light backgrounds
